comment: C2 slice fights (docs/COMBAT_2.md Part 5). Maps use the Lab legend (P party spawn, E enemy spawn, p pit, x crate, b barrel, O oil barrel, i ice, e ledge, s spikes, # wall). party: character ids. level: 1 or 6 (which loadouts, and the enemy scaling). nights: fights in a row with HP and spell charges carried over; "rest" is a rest room. teaches: the line the Lab shows before the fight.

fights.name: 1. First Down
fights.teaches: Gremlins are weak to Heat. Hit a weakness to knock an enemy down and get One More.

fights.name: 2. Edge of the Gym
fights.teaches: Push enemies into the pits. The Golem can't be moved.

fights.name: 3. Relay
fights.teaches: Each enemy is weak to something different. Baton Pass the One More to whoever has the right type.

fights.name: 4. Pep Squad
fights.teaches: Five weak enemies. Knock them all down for an All-Out Attack.

fights.name: 5. Wrong Answer
fights.teaches: These enemies resist most things. Scan them and switch Vectors.

fights.name: 6. Hollow Mascot
fights.teaches: The Mascot telegraphs its two big attacks a turn ahead. Get out of the marked tiles.

nights.name: Night: Three in a Row
nights.text: Three fights with HP and spell charges carried over, and one rest room.
